mapper.update: UPDATE asset_binding_release SET status='DEAD', lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, last_failure='lease-exhausted', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE status='LEASED' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND generation_attempts >= 10 ORDER BY lease_until, request_id LIMIT 100

UPDATE asset_binding_release SET status='LEASED', lease_token=#{token}, lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempts=attempts+1, generation_attempts=generation_attempts+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE generation_attempts < 10 AND attempts < 110 AND ((status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status='LEASED' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY created_at, request_id LIMIT 4
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM asset_binding_release WHERE status='LEASED' AND lease_token=#{token} ORDER BY created_at, request_id LIMIT 4
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_binding_release SET status='SENT', lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, last_failure=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND status='LEASED' AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE asset_binding_release SET status='DEAD''PENDING', lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, last_failure='release-unconfirmed', next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delaySeconds},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND status='LEASED' AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
